data.long_meaning: The woman who was known for her radiance and joy, often seen in her eyes and smile. in_pashto.name: حريره

data.cultural_impact: Hurrayrah is a beautiful Islamic name that derives from the Arabic word "hurrayraha," which means "glowing, radiant, and joyful." This name was given to a woman in Islamic history who was known for her beaming eyes and infectious smile. Her name became a symbol of happiness and brightness in the Islamic community, inspiring others to strive for joy and positivity in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, Hurrayrah also represents the inner radiance and joy that comes from a deep connection with Allah (God). The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his good deeds" (Bukhari and Muslim). Hurrayrah, as a symbol of inner joy and happiness, reminds us of the importance of engaging in good deeds and nurturing our relationship with Allah, as it is these actions that will bring us true happiness and inner peace both in this world and in the Hereafter.
